name: Absolve
description: Releases the user from all special conditions.

name: Alkaloid Mist
description: A powerful poison attack with a 30% chance of poisoning a foe. If Harsh Sunlight is active, that chance increases to 60%.

name: Aqua Jet
description: Hits the foe with a blast of water. Has a 30% chance to slow a target.

name: Aureal Flood
description: A majestic blast of purified water that deals high damage and removes all status conditions from the user's party.

name: Bite
description: A weak physical attack that has a 10% chance to make a foe flinch.

name: Blood Draw
description: Leeching attack that heals the user for 50% of the damage done.

name: Bloodmoon
description: Sets up the Bloodmoon weather for 3 turns. While active, the power of Dark type attacks is increased by 25%. Dark type attacks also heal the user for 10% of the damage dealt. Ghost type attacks have a 20% chance to burn a foe. Lastly, Light, Mystic and Normal type attacks deal -25% damage while Bloodmoon is active.

name: Bloom
description: Opens an enormous flower, increasing Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage and healing the user for 33% of their maximum health.

name: Body Slam
description: Uses the user's size to deal up to 150 Base Power. The user takes recoil equal to 15% of its maximum HP.

name: Boulder Drop
description: A powerful rock attack with a 10% chance to make the foe flinch.

name: Brilliant Light
description: A corrective blast of light that isn't affected by type resistance.

name: Bulk Up
description: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

name: Burn Off
description: Burns away all special conditions from the user.

name: Buzz
description: A weak bug attack that lowers a foe's Special Defense by 1 stage.

name: Cacophony
description: Stirs up a bombardment of mental noise, reducing a foe's Special Defense by 3 stages.

name: Celestial Chorus
description: Sets up the Celesital Chorus weather for 3 turns. While active, the power of Light type attacks is increased by 50%. Prayer heals 50% more damage, and Dark and Ghost type attacks also deal -50% damage while Celestial Chorus is active.

name: Challenging Call
description: Calls the foe to a challenge, lowering their attack by 1 stage, and adds a 80% chance for them to despair. If the foe is a Dragon type, it will always despair.

name: Charm
description: Attracts a target, infatuating them.

name: Chlorophyll Cannon
description: Fires off a superheated ball of chlorophyll, dealing heavy damage. Has a 20% chance to burn a foe.

name: Chromatic Thought
description: Raises stats according to the active weather. With no weather, raises every stat by 1 stage and restores 5% of maximum HP.

name: Cinder Flick
description: A weak fire attack that has a 30% chance to burn a foe.

name: Cleanse
description: Washes away all special conditions from the user.

name: Cleanse
description: Purifies the user of all special conditions.

name: Coat Toxin
description: Sprays poisonous gunk at a foe, dealing high damage. Has a 20% chance to poison a foe.

name: Constrict
description: Plant attack that has a 20% chance to paralyze a foe.

name: Counter
description: Retaliates a physical attack, dealing twice the damage the user sustained.

name: Croak
description: Lets out a Croak, reducing a foe's Special Defense by 1 stage. If the egg group of a foe is an Amphibian, it also applies a stack of infatuation.

name: Dazzle
description: A weak Mystic attack that needs a turn to recharge. Flinches a foe, and reduces their Special Defense by 1 stage.

name: Deep Impact
description: Strikes the foe with an ancient method, with a 10% flinch chance.

name: Defense Curl
description: Tightens the body, increasing the user's Defense by 1 stage.

name: Detect
description: Becomes immune to an attack this turn, but becomes less effective the more it is used.

name: Disable
description: Prevents the foe's last used move for 4 turns.

name: Discern
description: Correctly judges a situation, increasing the user's Special Defense by 3 stages.

name: Dormancy
description: The user cleanses itself and falls asleep. Upon waking, it fully heals and is cleansed again.

name: Doze Off
description: Heals one third of the user's maximum HP, then puts the user to sleep.

name: Drain
description: A weak plant attack that heals half of the damage dealt.

name: Drain Toxin
description: A weak plant attack that heals the user 15% of it's maximum HP. Any Poison weakness the user may have is removed for 3 turns after use.

name: Dream
description: Uses another move at random. Can only be used when the user is sleeping.

name: Drive Off
description: Charges a foe, dealing double the damage if the foe is lighter than the user. Always attacks first.

name: Epoch Crash
description: A devastating blow of the ages that may flinch the foe and lowers its Special Defense by 1 stage.

name: Evade
description: Becomes immune to an attack this turn, but becomes less effective the more it is used.

name: Fatal Jaw
description: Crushes the foe with a jaw of dense mineral and lowers its Defense by 1 stage.

name: Fey Dust
description: Scatters mystical dust on a foe, adding a stack of infatuation, and reducing their Special Defense by 2 stages.

name: Fey Gardens
description: Creates Fey Gardens weather for 3 turns. Mystic attacks deal 25% more damage; Plant and Mystic Fakemon gain 10% more maximum HP from healing moves, cannot have their Special Attack or Special Defense lowered, and gain an extra infatuation stack the first time they infatuate a foe.

name: Fin Flash
description: Strikes the foe with a flash of water. Its power increases from 40 to 60 if the user's Special Defense is raised.

name: Fire Charge
description: A fiery physical charge with a 10% chance to burn the foe. The user loses 25% of their current HP as recoil.

name: Fireheart
description: Kindles the user's inner flame, preventing them from fainting for 2 turns. This move has a 1-turn reuse delay.

name: Flamethrower
description: Scorches the foe with an intense stream of flame. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.

name: Flashcroak
description: Unleashes a fiery croak that has a 30% chance to confuse the foe.

name: Flip Turn
description: Attacks the foe, then switches the user with a random party member and passes along the user's stat changes.

name: Flutter
description: Flutters gracefully, raising the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

name: Fortify
description: Raises Defense by 2 stages, but lowers Speed by 1 stage.

name: Gather
description: Gathers strength to heal one third of the user's maximum HP and grants immunity to Confusion and Flinch on the next turn.

name: Gnaw
description: Gnaws at the foe 2 to 5 times in succession.

name: Grand Display
description: Stages a grand display, raising the user's Special Attack and Speed by 2 stages. For 2 turns, special attacks against the user poison the attacker.

name: Gust
description: Blasts the foe with a gust of air. Has a 20% chance to slow the foe.

name: Hammer Arm
description: Strikes the foe with a powerful arm.

name: Harsh Sunlight
description: Creates Harsh Sunlight weather for 3 turns. Fire and Plant attacks deal 50% more damage, while Water and Ice attacks deal 50% less damage.

name: Heat Up
description: Builds momentum with a burst of heat, dealing light damage while raising the user's Speed by 3 stages and Special Attack by 1 stage.

name: Hydraulic Crash
description: The user throws its full mass into the foe behind a crushing surge of water. Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage.

name: Hypnotic Hum
description: Hums a hypnotic tune, lowering the foe's Speed by 1 stage and giving them a 50% chance to fall asleep.

name: Hysteria
description: Assaults the foe in a frenzy. Has a 20% chance to paralyze the foe, increased to 30% during Rootmind.

name: Ignite
description: Ignites a small flame around the foe. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.

name: Incinerate
description: Engulfs the foe in flame. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.

name: Inferno
description: Unleashes a devastating inferno that burns the user's entire party and costs the user 80% of their current HP. Harsh Sunlight remains active.

name: Inferno Plume
description: Strikes with an overwhelming plume of fire. Has a 40% chance to burn the foe, but the user must recharge next turn.

name: Infest
description: Infests the foe, poisoning them.

name: Ink Jet
description: Fires a jet of Ink at the foe, lowering their Defense by 1 stage, then switches out for a random party member. Stat buffs are transfered to that new member.

name: Inner Focus
description: Clears all stat changes from the user and prevents their next move from causing self-damage.

name: Intercept
description: A swift aerial strike that acts with increased priority and has a 5% chance to make the foe flinch.

name: Kinetic Pummel
description: Pummels the foe with kinetic force. Has a 20% chance to lower the foe's Defense by 1 stage.

name: Leap
description: Leaps into the foe and grants the user's next move increased priority.

name: Leech Life
description: Drains the foe's vitality, healing the user for 50% of the damage dealt.

name: Lotus Absolution
description: A purifying light attack that doubles in power against a poisoned foe, then cures their poison. During Harsh Sunlight or Fey Gardens, it also heals one third of the user's maximum HP.

name: Lotus Dart
description: Launches a sharpened lotus at the foe. Has a 30% chance to poison the foe.

name: Magic Pulse
description: Fires a pulse of unstable magic with a 40% chance to randomly burn, poison, paralyze, condemn, despair, infatuate, slow, or confuse the foe.

name: Materialize
description: Changes all of the user's learned Special moves to Physical until it switches out.

name: Memorial
description: Gains 20 power per completed turn the user remains on the field, up to 200 power. Switching resets the power back to 60.

name: Mimic
description: Copies and uses the foe's last move.

name: Mind Bolt
description: Strikes with psychic force and has a 20% chance to make the foe flinch or become confused. The chance increases to 30% during Rootmind.

name: Mind Wave
description: Washes over the foe with psychic energy. Has a 20% chance to confuse the foe, increased to 30% during Rootmind.

name: Mist
description: Envelops the field in mist, clearing all stat changes from the user and foe.

name: Monsoon
description: Creates Monsoon weather for 3 turns. Water and Plant attacks deal 50% more damage, while Fire attacks deal 50% less damage. Steel types suffer from Rust.

name: Multitask
description: Raises 3 different random stats by 1 stage. HP may be selected, restoring 10% of maximum HP.

name: Mycelial Hunt
description: Hunts the foe through a mycelial network, increasing in power from 75 to 90 if the foe has a condition. During Rootmind, its power is 90, or 120 against a foe with a condition.

name: Mystic Stream
description: Channels a stream of mystic energy. Its power increases by 10% for each positive Speed stage the user has.

name: Nectar Drink
description: Drinks restorative nectar, healing 10% of the user's maximum HP and curing one condition.

name: Needle Nip
description: Nips the foe with a draining needle, healing the user for 50% of the damage dealt.

name: Nest
description: Restores 15% of the user's maximum HP. If the user is an Air type, it instead restores 33% and removes their Air typing for 2 turns.

name: Night Dart
description: A swift dark strike with increased priority. Its power doubles if the foe is asleep or confused.

name: Outlast
description: Power doubles if the foe has at least one raised stat.

name: Paradise Bloom
description: Clears all of the user's stat changes and removable conditions, then heals 15% of their maximum HP plus 10% for each stat stage cleared and 20% for each condition cleared.

name: Paradise Ray
description: Fires an immense ray that clears the weather and removes all conditions from both battlers after dealing damage. The user must recharge next turn.

name: Peck
description: Pecks the foe with a sharp beak.

name: Petal Whip
description: Strikes the foe with a whipping petal. Has a 20% chance to poison the foe; during Rootmind, its power rises from 40 to 45 and the chance becomes 30%.

name: Petalwake
description: Surges through the foe in a wake of petals, raising the user's Speed by 1 stage.

name: Phoenix Charge
description: A blazing charge with a 20% chance to burn the foe. The user loses 25% of their current HP as recoil but cannot faint for 2 turns. This move has a 1-turn reuse delay.

name: Photon Beam
description: Fires a concentrated beam of light at the foe.

name: Plague
description: Afflicts the foe with a virulent attack that always poisons them.

name: Poison Bubble
description: Blasts the foe with a toxic bubble. Has a 20% chance to poison the foe.

name: Poison Tongue
description: Lashes the foe with a poisonous tongue. Has a 30% chance to poison the foe.

name: Pounce
description: Pounces on the foe with a physical attack.

name: Prayer
description: Offers a prayer that heals the user for 33% of their maximum HP at the start of the next turn.

name: Puff Up
description: Puffs up menacingly, raising the user's Special Attack and Defense by 2 stages but lowering their Special Defense by 2 stages.

name: Punch
description: Strikes the foe with a punch.

name: Quick Bump
description: Quickly bumps into the foe. Has a 30% chance to make the foe flinch.

name: Regrow
description: Clears all of the user's stat changes and removable conditions, healing 10% of maximum HP for each effect cleared. During Rootmind, it heals 12.5% per effect instead.

name: Relic Strike
description: Strikes the foe with an ancient treasure, with a 5% flinch chance.

name: Remedy
description: Uses restorative growth to remove all special conditions.

name: Remembrance
description: Recalls and uses another eligible move from the user's learnset that they do not currently know.

name: Rest
description: Heals 50% of the user's maximum HP and cures all conditions, then puts the user to sleep.

name: Restore
description: Removes all special conditions from the user.

name: Rootmind
description: Creates Rootmind weather for 3 turns. Plant Fakemon heal 6.25% of their maximum HP at the end of each turn, and certain moves gain additional effects.

name: Rubble Slide
description: Buries the foe in mineral chunks, slowing it.

name: Scald
description: Blasts the foe with scalding water. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.

name: Scatter Stone
description: Strikes the foe with small rocks, with a 5% chance to make it flinch.

name: Scourge
description: Savages the foe with a brutal attack, but cannot make the target faint.

name: Scratch
description: Scratches the foe with sharp claws.

name: Sea Cutter
description: A thin, fast and sharp water projectile that isn't affected by type resistance.

name: Seed
description: Plants a restorative seed on the target. Starting after 1 turn, it heals 15% of the target's maximum HP at the end of each turn for 3 turns.

name: Shadow Snap
description: Snaps at the foe with a dark physical attack.

name: Singe
description: Singes the foe, burning them.

name: Skyfall
description: Drops onto the foe from above, using the foe's Defense in place of the user's Attack when calculating damage.

name: Slash
description: Slashes the foe with a sharp attack.

name: Sleep Off
description: Cures all of the user's conditions, then puts the user to sleep.

name: Sleep Swing
description: A wild sleeping attack that can only be used while asleep. Has a 20% chance to lower the foe's Defense by 1 stage.

name: Sleep Talk
description: Attacks through sleep with a weak burst of energy. Can only be used while the user is asleep.

name: Smite
description: Smites the foe with radiant power. Has a 20% chance to condemn the foe.

name: Snore
description: A noisy attack that can only be used while asleep. Has a 20% chance to make the foe flinch.

name: Soak
description: Soaks the foe with chilling water. Has a 15% chance to freeze the foe.

name: Solar Ray
description: Focuses sunlight into a powerful ray. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.

name: Squawk
description: Startles the foe with a piercing squawk, lowering their Defense by 1 stage.

name: Stare
description: Fixes the foe with an intense stare, lowering their Special Defense by 1 stage.

name: Stare
description: Fixes the foe with a psychic stare, lowering their Defense by 1 stage.

name: Stone Gnaw
description: If the target is a Rock type, heals the user for all damage dealt.

name: Sun Chorus
description: Sings a scorching chorus that lowers the foe's Special Defense by 3 stages. During Harsh Sunlight, it also infatuates the foe.

name: Swarm
description: Gathers a swarm around the user, doubling the power of their next Bug-type attack.

name: Swoop
description: Swoops down on the foe with increased priority.

name: Synaptic Bloom
description: Triggers a bloom of psychic energy, increasing in power from 80 to 100 if the user has any stat change. During Rootmind, its power is 90, or 110 if the user has a stat change.

name: Tentacle Grip
description: A weak tentacle attack that gains info on the opponent, slowing them and lowering their special defense and defense by 1 stage.

name: Torment
description: Torments the foe, preventing them from using the same move twice in a row.

name: Toxic Flare
description: Ignites a toxic flare. Its power is increased by 50% against a poisoned foe, whose poison is then replaced with a burn.

name: Valiance
description: Strong contact move with a low chance to do recoil damage to the user.

name: Veil
description: Raises a ghostly veil that protects the user from attacks this turn. Repeated use is less likely to succeed.

name: Vicegrip
description: Crushes the foe in a powerful grip and prevents them from voluntarily switching out for 2 turns.

name: Vital Cognition
description: Heals 25% of the user's maximum HP. If the user has a condition, it cures all removable conditions; otherwise, it raises Special Attack by 2 stages. During Rootmind, the healing increases to one third of maximum HP.

name: Warning Flare
description: Displays a toxic warning, raising the user's Special Attack and Speed by 1 stage. For 2 turns, physical attacks against the user poison the attacker.

name: Whirlwind
description: Whips up a whirlwind that forces the foe to switch with a random party member.

name: Winds of Time
description: Creates Winds of Time for 3 turns, cleansing the field, empowering Ancient and Air attacks, and progressively healing Ancient types.

name: Wingbeat
description: Batters the foe with powerful wings. Has a 20% chance to lower the foe's Defense by 1 stage.
